name: rosegold
description: Language support for RoseGold: syntax highlighting, editor config, and a native language server (diagnostics, hover, go-to-definition, completion).

rosegold.compilerPath.description: Path to the rosegoldc binary (the language server runs as 'rosegoldc --lsp'). If empty, the extension searches the workspace and the file's parent folders for cpp/rosegoldc or rosegoldc.

rosegold.trace.server.description: Trace the JSON-RPC traffic between VS Code and the RoseGold language server.
